```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Consultation Requests

  Scenario: Medicines are delivered as prescribed by the doctor (offline)
    Given the doctor has prescribed medicines for a patient
    When the system processes the prescription offline
    Then the medicines are delivered as per the doctor's prescription

  Scenario: Register a new Patient
    Given the system is ready to accept new patient registrations
    When a new patient details are provided
    Then the patient is registered with the system

  Scenario Outline: View and Update the details of an existing Patient
    Given the patient with ID <patient_id> exists in the system
    When the patient details are updated with <new_name> and <new_age>
    Then the patient details are updated to <new_name> and <new_age>
    Examples:
      | patient_id | new_name | new_age |
      | 1          | Alice    | 30      |
      | 2          | Bob      | 40      |
      | 3          | Charlie  | 50      |

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details - No Consultation Requests in last 3 years
    Given the patient with ID 1 has no consultation requests in the last 3 years
    When the system attempts to delete the patient details
    Then the patient details are successfully deleted

  Scenario: Delete the Patient Details - Consultation Requests in last 3 years
    Given the patient with ID 2 has consultation requests in the last 3 years
    When the system attempts to delete the patient details
    Then the system displays an error message "Cannot delete patient with recent consultation requests"

  Scenario: Rollback by a month - Exact month boundary
    Given the system has data for the current month and the previous month
    When the system performs a rollback by a month
    Then the system reverts to the state of the previous month

  Scenario: Restore backup on dummy production system
    Given a backup of the production database exists
    When the backup is restored on the dummy production system
    Then the dummy production system contains the complete and correct data from the backup

  Scenario: Purge dummy production database
    Given the dummy production database contains data
    When the system purges the dummy production database
    Then the dummy production database is empty

  Scenario: Location constraint for backup storage
    Given the system requires a secure location for backup storage
    When the system checks the backup storage location
    Then the backup is stored in Mangalore HQ in a fire proof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
```
